settled_start_provenance.meaning: Nominal physics-v2 rest after20s home hold, zero-velocity reset; xy recentered. Provisional mass/actuators, not physically measured.

base_payload.basis: 50g provisional sum: controller product listing16g (not weighed bare board); IMU carrier10g, additional mount15g and local wires/fasteners9g are engineering estimates. Existing CAD Waveshare mounting plate already in base is not counted again. Box geometry/COM are estimated, not a collision or protected-clearance model. External tether mass is not added to links; drag model retained.

actuator_provenance.variant: 12V ST-3215-C018, user sticker identifies12VSTS3215; detailed suffix not independently measured
actuator_provenance.nominal_rationale: 1.5Nm is the lower approved provisional choice between rated and stall;4rad/s below catalog no-load. Independent box limits do not model torque-speed or thermal/current envelope. Not continuous ratings or hardware authorization.

velocity_constraint_provisional_notes.semantics: velocity_limit_sim is a joint velocity constraint. PhysX drive/contact/limit corrections can conflict; observed brief PD-opposing overspeed is provisionally accepted, not a proven physical back-drive model. No artificial clamp.
velocity_constraint_provisional_notes.monitoring: Per completed physics step before autoreset: actual per-environment caps, peak absolute joint speed, environment-time fraction over cap+0.001rad/s. Flag >1% time or estimated PD-driven overspeed sustained >=0.05s. PD sign is a proxy, not measured solver torque.
velocity_constraint_provisional_notes.unvalidated: Actuator torque-speed/thermal/back-drive properties and contact geometry remain unmeasured; numerical convergence probes do not establish hardware fidelity.
